posts.author: turbobumblepuppy
posts.body:
I've converted a character sheet from VX Ace to MV, but in the game some pixels that should be on one character pop up in another character's image in certain frames.
The original VX Ace image size is 552, and according to this thread I need to resize the sheet at 1.5x the amount, which I calculate would be 828 pixels (69 wide for each individual vertical character part):
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/importing-rpg-maker-vx-ace-sprites-into-mv.47004/
I don't see what I'm doing wrong or how else to resize the sheet to make it work. It's probably a regular issue, but I can't see any answers for it anywhere. Apologies if I missed it. Any help greatly appreciated!

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
This tends to happen if your original VXAce sprites fill their cells completely with zero margin. Resizing by 1.5x is naturally never going to be pixel perfect...
Personally, I'd just brush these up manually. The left-facing triplet can be moved one pixel to the left in its entirety. The top and bottom triplet you'll have to chip off some pixels from the hair... I suspect it's not only bleeding to the neighboring sprite, but also between the frames.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You should also adjust the vertical spacing. I see empty gaps between all of those cels - you take the height of the tallest character in the sheet, and that's your cel height.
That character should be positioned so their feet are one pixel above the top of their head. All other characters only have any space if their head is shorter.
